import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
# sat comps, by hue ranges
for name,mask in [
 ('sat80',(hsv[:,:,1]>80).astype(np.uint8)),('sat120',(hsv[:,:,1]>120).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('dark',(np.max(im,2)<45).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('blackish',((np.max(im,2)<70)&(np.mean(im,2)<45)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('red',(((hsv[:,:,0]<10)|(hsv[:,:,0]>170))&(hsv[:,:,1]>100)&(hsv[:,:,2]>50)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('orange',((hsv[:,:,0]>=10)&(hsv[:,:,0]<25)&(hsv[:,:,1]>100)&(hsv[:,:,2]>60)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('yellow',((hsv[:,:,0]>=25)&(hsv[:,:,0]<40)&(hsv[:,:,1]>100)&(hsv[:,:,2]>60)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('green',((hsv[:,:,0]>=40)&(hsv[:,:,0]<90)&(hsv[:,:,1]>80)&(hsv[:,:,2]>30)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('blue',((hsv[:,:,0]>=90)&(hsv[:,:,0]<135)&(hsv[:,:,1]>80)&(hsv[:,:,2]>30)).astype(np.uint8)),
 ('purple',((hsv[:,:,0]>=135)&(hsv[:,:,0]<170)&(hsv[:,:,1]>50)&(hsv[:,:,2]>30)).astype(np.uint8))]:
  n,lab,stats,cent=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask,8)
  arr=[]
  for i in range(1,n):
    x,y,w,h,a=stats[i]
    if a>100: arr.append((a,x,y,w,h,tuple(np.round(cent[i],1))))
  arr=sorted(arr,reverse=True)[:20]
  print('\\n',name,'pixels',int(mask.sum()),'comps')
  for z in arr: print(z)
PY"
